text: NIF Holding (Italy) S.r.l. holds 6% of Technogym S.p.A.'s share capital; the Public Investment Fund (PIF), based in Saudi Arabia, is at the head of NIF Holding's control structure.
short: NIF Holding (Italy), with PIF at the head of its control structure, holds 6% of Technogym.

source.name: Technogym S.p.A. 2025 Annual Report (Board of directors' report, Shareholders)
source.quote: (ii) 6% by NIF Holding (Italy) S.r.l., a limited liability company incorporated under Italian law, with the Public Investment Fund (PIF), based in Saudi Arabia, at the head of its control structure

additionalSources.name: Argaam: NEOM Investment Fund buys 6% of Italy's Technogym for $120.8M
additionalSources.quote: NEOM Investment Fund (NIF) announced acquiring a 6% stake in Italy-based leading manufacturer of wellness equipment and services Technogym, after injecting investments worth €111 million
